title: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba Floatation and Control Second Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba Floatation and Control Second Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 1985
ACT XIII OF 1985
MODARABA COMPANIES AND MODARABA (FLOATATION AND CONTROL) (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Modaraba Companies and Modarabas
(Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) (Second
Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

ACT XIII OF 1985

MODARABA COMPANIES AND MODARABA (FLOATATION AND CONTROL) (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Modaraba Companies and Modarabas
(Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 5,
Ordinance XXXI of 1980.--In
the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980
(XXXI of 1980), in section 5, in clause (b), for the word "five
million" the words "two and a half million" shall be
substituted.
